## How I Made It

A short code chunk that shows the core of how the chart was produced:

```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("data.csv")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
ax.plot(df["year"], df["price"])
ax.set_title("Example Chart")
plt.show()
```
